descriptionText: The product is a 2024-25 Panini NBA Hoops trading card featuring Shai Gilgeous-Alexander of the Oklahoma City Thunder. It is part of the Hoops Tribute subset and has a card number of 283. The card is a base set card in the Panini NBA Hoops collection for the specified season.
